composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Invent a small seed sprite whose oval body is wrapped in one thick braided-wool coil. A pale linen face sits inside the upper opening, with short cloth hands near the belly and two broad feet. Give it a thoughtful contented expression. Use warm taupe yarn with one muted teal seam and a pale blue background. Show the braid structure clearly, avoiding tangled fibers, hats, or mystical symbols. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
